description.value: Centennial Outdoor Pool is a City of Port Coquitlam-operated outdoor swimming facility located on Chester Street in the Tri-Cities area. Run by the municipality as part of its aquatics programming alongside spray parks and indoor pools, it offers a seasonal aquatic destination for residents and visitors. The facility is wheelchair accessible and charges an admission fee, making it a potential summer refreshment stop for touring cyclists passing through Port Coquitlam.

OSM confirms it is a fee-based, wheelchair-accessible outdoor swimming facility (fee=yes, wheelchair=yes, sport=swimming). A significant concern is that the OSM record assigns this location to the community 'North Vancouver,' but the coordinates (49.27°N, 122.78°W) and the City of Port Coquitlam website both clearly place it in Port Coquitlam.
